summary: [QE][Build 20300102] openQA test fails in zypper_in - apache2 not installable, libapr-1.so.0 missing
body:
## Observation
openQA test in scenario `opensuse-Tumbleweed-DVD-x86_64-textmode@64bit` fails
in zypper_in:
https://openqa.example.org/tests/500#step/zypper_in/12
Found in: Build 20300102, openSUSE Tumbleweed, x86_64
apache2 cannot be installed because libapr-1.so.0 is missing from the
repository; the test only runs zypper, so this is a product bug.
    # zypper -n in apache2; echo "exit=$?"
    Problem: nothing provides 'libapr-1.so.0()(64bit)' needed by apache2
    exit=4

## Test suite description
Textmode installation with extra console tests.

## Reproducible
Fails since Build 20300102 (https://openqa.example.org/tests/500);
3 of 3 runs. Not reproduced outside openQA.

## Expected result
Expected: apache2 installs.
Actual: zypper aborts with the missing dependency above.
Last good: Build 20300101 (https://openqa.example.org/tests/480), where
libapr1 was still in the repository.

## Further details
Not affected: none checked on other arches.
Suspected: libapr1 dropped from the build; not verified in OBS.
Latest: https://openqa.example.org/tests/latest?test=textmode&arch=x86_64
notes: Searched boo quicksearch 'libapr-1.so.0' and 'apache2 zypper' (open and closed): no match. Component Other is a best fit.
